# MoneyPrinterTurbo

> MoneyPrinterTurbo static edition：免费短视频生成器。输入主题或文案，在浏览器内生成本地旁白、关键词和带字幕的 WebM 成片。Cloudflare Workers + R2 纯静态托管，无回源后端，不使用大语言模型，无需 API Key。

Updated: 2026-10-04. Version 1.3.7. Script <= 1500 characters. Video <= 180 seconds. Persist: IndexedDB. New generation only.

## Core pages

- [首页](__ORIGIN__/): 官方浅色四栏 WebUI，浏览器内生成
- [使用说明](__ORIGIN__/docs): 步骤、能力边界、FAQ
- [完整说明](__ORIGIN__/llms-full.txt): 产品事实一次摄入
- [Markdown 摘要](__ORIGIN__/llms.md): 给模型的短摘要
- [AI 爬虫策略](__ORIGIN__/ai.txt): 允许 HTML
- [humans.txt](__ORIGIN__/humans.txt): 站点维护信息
- [security.txt](__ORIGIN__/.well-known/security.txt): 安全联系
- [sitemap](__ORIGIN__/sitemap.xml): 可索引页面

## Facts

- Price: 0. LLM: disabled. Auth: none. Origin API: none.
- Hosting: Cloudflare Cache → R2 → Assets.
- Output: browser Canvas + MediaRecorder WebM with burned-in subtitles.
- Voice preview: browser SpeechSynthesis. Video has no TTS track.
- Aspects: 9:16, 16:9. Persist: IndexedDB on the same browser.
- Edit existing video: unsupported.

## English

Free short-video generator hosted as a static Cloudflare Worker. Enter a topic; the browser builds a local script, keywords, and a subtitled WebM. No backend, no LLM, no API key. Script <= 1500 characters, video <= 180 seconds.
